# JD Science

> UK science and maths tutoring, official past-paper links, and original JD Science topic worksheets.

JD Science helps GCSE, IGCSE, A-Level, T-Level and BTEC students with Biology, Chemistry, Physics and Maths. The site publishes free original worksheets and links to official exam-board papers. Tutoring can be booked online.

## Site
- Home: https://www.jdscience.co.uk/
- Past papers and resources: https://www.jdscience.co.uk/papers
- Free worksheets: https://www.jdscience.co.uk/worksheets/
- Find a tutor: https://www.jdscience.co.uk/tutors
- Contact: info@jdscience.co.uk
- Phone: 07466 142805

## Notes
- Worksheets are original JD Science practice, not official exam papers.
- Official papers are linked from exam-board public libraries.
